name: moonshotai/kimi-k2.6
description: Kimi K2.6 is Moonshot AI's general-purpose multimodal model, taking text, image and video input with both thinking and non-thinking modes and a 256K-token context. Moonshot highlights more reliable long-horizon coding across languages such as Rust, Go and Python and tasks like frontend, DevOps and performance optimization, along with stronger instruction following, self-correction and autonomous agent execution. Choose Kimi K3 for flagship-level work with a 1M context.
